The absence of an F-Pβ-3 base measurement means the 'lift from base' for Pβ on hybrid composite is structurally undefined (probably also RED ~0.005-0.010 range based on phase1_5 sentinel pattern).

F1_v3 V2 hybrid is unweighted equal-weight (BLEU-1 + ROUGE-L + chrF) / 3 — NOT a principled multi-metric weighting (e.g., chrF tends to dominate on substrate-style outputs because character n-gram overlap is more lenient than token n-gram). A weighted variant (e.g., ROUGE-L 0.5 + BLEU-1 0.3 + chrF 0.2) would shift the composite by ~0.001-0.003, NOT enough to cross any band threshold. The unweighted form follows the spec literal.

#115 chat-incapability carry: CLM v4 base substrate was NEVER SFT'd and NEVER RLHF'd in original training; the LoRA distill (Paradigm D) is the FIRST training pass adding any instruction-following signal. 50K steps of LoRA distill is structurally insufficient to lift this substrate to chat capability when Llama-3.2-3B (heavily SFT'd + RLHF'd) achieves ~0.382 BLEU-1 and Pβ achieves ~0.0075. The F-Pβ-3 FAIL is consistent with #115; it confirms not refutes the substrate's known limitation.

F1_v2 band thresholds (YELLOW 0.50 / GREEN 0.75) were calibrated in docs/n_substrate_f1_v2_banding_spec_2026_05_04.md for the F1_score_v2 substrate-axis-weighted-sum semantic, NOT for the F1_v3 V2 hybrid (BLEU-1+ROUGE-L+chrF)/3 closed-book completion semantic. Re-using the same banding for both is a semantic stretch — the closed-book completion regime has a much lower achievable ceiling (Llama itself estimated ~0.39 < YELLOW 0.50). For this metric/eval pair, RED/YELLOW/GREEN are emitted but should be read as 'noise-floor / suggestive-lift / Llama-class' rather than literal substrate-research bands. Cross-eval comparability is preserved by reporting raw composite alongside the band.
